lines.t: He lives, He lives, Yahushua lives
He lives, He lives, He lives, Yahushua lives
Storm away, the grave undone
Death defeated by the Holy One
Firstfruits risen, the victory won
Light of the world, the risen sun
No more silence, no more grave
He is risen, strong to save
He lives, He lives, our Redeemer lives
Firstfruits risen, life He gives
He lives, He lives, we lift Him high
Yahushua lives, He will never die
Alive, alive, He is alive in me
Alive, alive, for all eternity
Chains are broken, tomb is bare
Power of heaven, fill the air
Not held down, He rose in might
King of glory, robed in life
Grave has lost, it has no claim
All authority in His name
He lives, He lives, our Redeemer lives
Firstfruits risen
Life begins
